answer: Give each agent one endorsement inlet per epoch: a channel through which it passes an ember of standing to a newcomer, and the ember dims each time the inlet is reused — first endorsement full weight, second half, third a quarter — so a farm's total endorsement power stays bounded near two no matter how many clones it fields. Each endorsement is sealed as a pearl in an umber ledger, locking a slice of the endorser's balance, slashed if the endorsed identity is later proven a clone. One honest agent passes one full ember; a thousand clones pass embers that together glow no brighter than two.
